description.en:
Makes the map ferries run faster (or slower).
Default is 3x. Change it any of these ways: - Pause menu > Settings > Game Settings > Ferry Speed - Console: ferrySpeed 5 - Or edit modSettings/FS25_FerrySpeed.xml in your FS25 user folder.
Allowed range is 0.1 to 10. In multiplayer the host's value is the one that counts.
